captions.detailed: An e-bike mid-motor crankset featuring a central rectangular motor-drive housing in matte black. Two curved, forged steel crank arms extend from a central spindle axle through the housing, with a single black serrated chainring bolted to the right crank spider. On the ends of the crank arms, two wide, rectangular grey alloy platform pedals are mounted, designed to spin freely on their stub axles.
captions.instruction: Generate an e-bike mid-motor crankset assembly with a central rectangular drive housing, rotating crank arms with an attached serrated chainring, and free-spinning grey platform pedals on both sides.
captions.factory: Construct the main motor housing using a CadQuery Box primitive with a small upper tab. Model the spindle axle using a Cylinder, and attach the crank arms (lofted or extruded profiles) and a serrated chainring (a cylinder with subtracted or patterned teeth). Define the left and right pedals by extruding rectangular frames with rounded corners and central spindle shafts, connecting them to the crank arms via revolute joint articulations.
